QuestInfo.name: The Clocktower Headache
QuestInfo.0: I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
QuestInfo.1: You met Grandpa Clock deep in the halls of Lost Time of Ludibrium. He's bothered by the tiny Ticks that have been going inside the clocktower and destroying parts of it... You must eliminate 80 #bTicks#k at #b#m220040200##k for Grandpa Clock.
QuestInfo.2: I took care of the request #p2040029# made, by taking out the #bTicks#k. The Ticks were another one of the reasons the clocktower seemed to have something wrong at all times, so this should give #p2040029# a good night's sleep.

0.0: What brings you all the way here? I haven't seen a human being in ages. You're much better company than those rascals pulling my Clocktower apart. You have the look of an adventurer... Can you clean out those pests for me?

yes.0: I can't believe you said yes! Well, here are the details. There have been monsters contaminated with the dark force that seems to emanate here, and one of the worst seems to be #b#o3210207##k, but I can't do a thing about it.
yes.1: They use their small bodies to penetrate their way into the huge clock and cause all kinds of troubles this way. The clock is vulnerable in multiple spots to begin with, and they tend to attack in bunches, so the workers have a hard time fixing it. That's why...
yes.2: Come back when you eliminate #r80#k of those infuriating #r#o3210207##k critters. You can recognize a #o3210207# by the clock on its back. Horrid little things, they are.

no.0: We need your help desperately. Who am I going to ask for this... if you have a change of heart, then please talk to me

1.0: What took you? Surely no #r#o3210207##k could stand in your way. I heard that you cleaned them out, so thank you for that. I have a little reward for you, if you want it.

yes.0: You got the #b#t2000011##k, right? All of them? Good, good. I haven't seen a single #r#o3210207##k in awhile, so you've definitely done some good. Unfortunately, that's not the only problem we're facing.

mob.0: Eliminate 80 of the #r#o3210207##k critters tearing the Clocktower apart.
